h1: One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot — Fresh, Clean, Spacious Rooms on a Budget Near Robinson in Mae Sot
intro: If you're after a Mae Sot stay with fresh, spacious rooms close to the mall, One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot is a name budget travellers are increasingly talking about · A 3-star budget hotel that opened in 2024 on the Asia Highway, just about 1 km from Robinson Lifestyle, with modern rooms, strong AC, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a buffet breakfast · It scores a strong 8.7 from 143 real reviews on Trip.com. Reviews most often mention fresh, clean, spacious and quiet rooms; the trade-offs are some hallway footstep noise and a breakfast that's still finding its feet. Rooms start from approx. ฿780/night

body.html: One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot is a 3-star budget hotel that opened in 2024, set on the Asia Highway in Mae Sot district, Tak province, close to the Thai-Myanmar border · What gives it an edge is that it's a new building — rooms still feel fresh and clean — and it's only about 1 km from Robinson Lifestyle, so you can walk over for a meal, shopping or a movie · Cross-border business travellers, tourists using Mae Sot as a base before heading to Umphang and the Thi Lo Su waterfall, and anyone who wants a fresh, spacious room for a few hundred to a thousand-odd baht tend to pick it for the value and the near-the-mall location.

Rooms range from Superior Single, Standard King and Superior Twin up to family rooms · The most common praise is that rooms are fresh, clean, more spacious than expected at this price, and quiet · Every room has strong AC, a TV and an en-suite bathroom with hot water, in bright tones that keep things feeling clean · The trade-off to know going in is that this is a genuine budget hotel — there's no pool or gym and facilities are just-enough · It's a place that stands out for fresh rooms, cleanliness and location rather than luxury or big-hotel service.
"Room was brand new, clean, and more spacious than I expected — comfy bed, cold AC, and an easy walk to Robinson. There's parking too. For this price in Mae Sot it's genuinely good value."

Facilities are pitched right for a budget stay · There's an elevator, free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, a multipurpose room, all-day security and CCTV · A daily buffet breakfast is served, and children under 12 eat free · The limits reviews mention are that you can sometimes hear footsteps or noise from the hallway — it's a new building with a shared corridor — and that breakfast quality isn't consistent on every day, the kind of thing a just-opened hotel can iron out.

The location is on the Asia Highway on the approach into Mae Sot town · It's about 1 km from Robinson Lifestyle Mae Sot and around 6 km from Mae Sot Airport, about an 11-minute drive · It's near the Somdej Phra Naresuan Maharat Shrine, with dozens of restaurants within about 1 km · The thing to factor in is that it sits on a main road — without a car you may need a Grab to reach the old market area or the Rim Moei border crossing — but overall it's handier than many budget hotels in Mae Sot because you can walk to the mall · The blended score sits around 8.7 from 143 real reviews on Trip.com, and it holds a Travellers' Choice award on Tripadvisor.

To be honest, One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot is a just-opened budget hotel, not a full-service property or a resort with extra facilities · You can sometimes hear the hallway, breakfast isn't fully consistent yet, and there's no pool or gym · If you expect service that's polished at every point or in-house activities, it may not be the one · But seen as a fresh, clean, spacious, quiet room for a few hundred to a thousand-odd baht, within walking distance of Robinson — it does its job well and is genuine value for budget travellers in Mae Sot.

Tips from following the reviews here: ask for a higher floor or a room away from the main corridor for more quiet, which cuts down the footstep noise · If you're here to shop, pick a city-view room and count on a short walk over to Robinson · There's a room deposit of around ฿500, refunded at check-out, so have it ready · A car makes the most sense, since you're on a main road with ample free parking · And always compare the live price on Agoda and Booking before you book, since rates move with the season and promotions.

If you expect a consistent breakfast and polished service — the hotel opened in 2024 and breakfast isn't consistent every day → if breakfast matters most, plan to eat at a restaurant near the mall.

faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travellers, cross-border business visitors, and anyone who wants a fresh, spacious room near the mall in Mae Sot · It suits self-drivers, since it's on a main road with free parking, and travellers using Mae Sot as a base before Umphang and the Thi Lo Su waterfall who want a clean room for a few hundred to a thousand-odd baht.

faq.q: What are the rooms and cleanliness like at One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot?
faq.a: Fresh, spotlessly clean rooms that are more spacious than expected, and quiet are the common praise, since it's a building that opened in 2024 · Every room has AC, a TV and an en-suite with hot water, in bright tones that keep things feeling clean · The trade-off is that it's a budget hotel — no pool or gym — and some rooms pick up footsteps from the hallway.

faq.q: Does One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot have Wi-Fi and breakfast?
faq.a: There's free Wi-Fi and free parking throughout · A daily buffet breakfast is served, and children under 12 eat free, though several reviews note breakfast quality isn't consistent on every day since the hotel just opened · If breakfast matters most, there are dozens of restaurants near the mall to choose from.

faq.q: Are the review scores for One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot reliable?
faq.a: One Budget Hotel Tak Maesot has a blended score around 8.7 from 143 real reviews on Trip.com and holds a Travellers' Choice award on Tripadvisor · Its strengths are fresh rooms, cleanliness and the near-the-mall location, making it a reliable budget pick in Mae Sot for a fresh room within walking distance of Robinson — the points still being refined are some service and the breakfast, since it just opened.
